The control flow is equivalent: bracket depth clamps the same way, the skip and declaration handling run in the same order, and `seen.Add` still runs only for qualifying foreign references; the method now scores about 14–15, though I couldn't find the source anywhere on this machine, so the build depends on the helper signatures' assumed types (`Foreign`, `List<(int From, int To)>`) matching the real declarations.
